# Project Phoenix v61.0 — 13th-Century Mongol & Cross-Era Portrait Attire Overhaul.
# Generated by tools/gen_v610_portrait_attire_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Character scope (portrait modifiers at priority = 105, selection_behavior = max).
# Uses ONLY vanilla tags, culture_groups, graphical cultures, government_types & Main Mod oe_v49/oe_v495/oe_v56
# helpers so Main Mod passes strict standalone audits and seamlessly governs all 12 eras (361-1821).
# Pure declarative boolean triggers: zero if/else blocks inside scripted_triggers.

# Secular adult male guard that ALLOWS field generals (needed for Mongol warlord Khans & Early Modern generals).
oe_v61_portrait_eligible_male_any_role = {
	exists = this
	is_adult = yes
	NOT = { is_female = yes }
	is_religious_figure = no
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
	NOT = { portrait_clergy_trigger = { RELIGION_GFX = buddhist_gfx } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:theocracy } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { has_reform = government_reform:military_order_reform } }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = yes }
}

# --- PART A: 13TH-CENTURY MONGOL & STEPPE ATTIRE OVERHAUL ---

# 1. Martial / Wartime Mongol Great Khans & Conquest Princes (Genghis Khan mil=99, Jochi, Chagatai, Ogedei, Batu, Hulegu)
#    -> Conical Steppe War Helm + Steppe Lamellar / Studded Brigandine Armor (never Qing fur cap or orange robe!).
oe_v61_mongol_khan_warlord = {
	oe_v61_portrait_eligible_male_any_role = yes
	oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = { country_rank_level >= 3 }
		any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		AND = {
			is_heir = yes
			employer ?= {
				OR = {
					country_rank_level >= 3
					government_type = government_type:steppe_horde
				}
			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		is_general = yes
		mil >= 70
		any_ruling_countries = { at_war = yes }
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1150
			current_year <= 1368
			employer ?= { at_war = yes }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Mongol & East-Asian Steppe Field Generals (Subutai, Jebe, Muqali, steppe commanders) -> Conical Helm + Lamellar Armor
oe_v61_mongol_steppe_general = {
	oe_v61_portrait_eligible_male_any_role = yes
	NOT = { oe_v61_mongol_khan_warlord = yes }
	is_general = yes
	OR = {
		oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
		oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = yes
	}
}

# 3. Peacetime / Court Mongol Great Khans, Regional Khans & Heirs (mil < 70, at peace)
#    -> Steppe Fur-Rimmed Crown Cap (zero Manchu red tassel) + Royal Belted Split Kaftan.
oe_v61_mongol_khan_court = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
	NOT = { oe_v61_mongol_khan_warlord = yes }
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = { country_rank_level >= 3 }
		any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		is_heir = yes
	}
}

# 4. Mongol Noyans, Cabinet, Minor Khans & East-Asian-GFX Steppe Courtiers
#    -> Tassel-free Dark Sable/Gold Crown Cap + Re-textured Deep Cobalt/Crimson/Sable Steppe Deel.
oe_v61_mongol_steppe_noble = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v61_mongol_khan_warlord = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v61_mongol_steppe_general = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v61_mongol_khan_court = yes }
	OR = {
		oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
		oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = yes
	}
}

# 5. Non-Muslim Mongol & Steppe Khatuns (e.g., Borte): clean braided hair (no Ming phoenix cap) + royal belted steppe silk robe.
#    Islamic Ulus Khatuns (GLH, ILK, CHG after Islamization) keep syrian_imperial/syrian_royalty via oe_v56 (priority 104).
oe_v61_female_mongol_steppe_khatun = {
	oe_v56_female_mongol_steppe_khatun = yes
}

# --- PART B: CROSS-ERA AUTHENTIC PORTRAIT LAYERING (361-768 LATE ANTIQUITY & 1648-1821 EARLY MODERN) ---

# 6. Late Antiquity Roman Emperors (361-768, BYZ/ROM, Rank 4 Monarchy):
#    Provides imperial crown & robes without D008 DLC lock; yields gracefully when D008 Byzantine/Roman regalia is installed
#    for east_mediterranean_gfx / roman_gfx while guaranteeing non-D008 and Latin-gfx Roman emperors look imperial.
oe_v61_late_antique_roman_emperor = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	current_year < 800
	is_ruler = yes
	any_ruling_countries = {
		country_rank_level >= 4
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		OR = {
			tag = BYZ
			tag = ROM
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
		}
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix" }
		NOR = {
			gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx
			gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx
		}
	}
}

oe_v61_late_antique_roman_empress = {

	any_ruling_countries = {

		OR = {
			tag = BYZ

			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
		}
	}
	OR = {

		NOR = {
			gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx
			gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx
		}
	}
}

# 7. Late Antiquity Sassanid / Pre-Islamic Persian Shahs (current_year < 700, iranian_group rulers)
#    -> Royal Persianate Split Kaftan + Imperial Jeweled Crown/Plume Turban (syrian_imperial).
oe_v61_late_antique_sassanid_shah = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	current_year < 700
	is_ruler = yes
	culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:iranian_group }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde } }
}

oe_v61_late_antique_sassanid_queen = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	current_year < 700
	is_ruler = yes
	culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:iranian_group }
}

# 8. Early Modern European Kings, Emperors & Generals (1648-1821, european_gfx, male rulers & generals)
#    -> Period-authentic Early Modern Tricorn Hat + Early Modern Tailored Coat (never medieval 1337 hoods/helms!).
#    Preserves east_mediterranean_gfx (Byzantine), roman_gfx, Muslim Balkan/Ottoman, Mongol, and Jurchen/Manchu attire.
oe_v61_early_modern_euro_tricorn = {
	oe_v61_portrait_eligible_male_any_role = yes
	current_year >= 1648
	gfx_culture_applicable = european_gfx
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	NOT = { oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	OR = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_general = yes
	}
}
